Composed from `HeroSection`, `BackgroundGlow` * and `BrowserMockup`. */ export function HeroTerminal({ kicker, title, description, actions, browserUrl, browserVariant = "terminal", glowTone = "primary", className, children, ...props }: HeroTerminalProps) { return (
